The prize money on "EMERALD MINE 9X" leans toward the smaller prizes. It is spread over thirteen prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $500,000. Games built like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

If you play "EMERALD MINE 9X" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
